scenario: [LTHE.4.7]: `within` on a `then` step takes a positive duration; `then ... within 0_s` is DS_VALIDATE_ZERO_WITHIN, because a zero window admits no pair of distinct instants. `Door` then `Motion within 0_s`, both schemas carrying the `ts` slot [LTHE.4.5] requires, so the zero window is the program's only defect. `compiler/RLOW.5.4.3` pins the same code on a single pattern's `within 0_s`, which LTHE.4.7 does not cover.
rules_ds:
schema Door scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

rule entry:
    Door
    then Motion within 0_s
->
    log info "entry"
